name: Zhuo Zhi Ling
source:
Qiu Jinsha, a 16-year-old girl who has always lived life like a normal person, is actually the eldest daughter in a family of spiritual masters.

At night she goes into the deepest part of the mountains alone in order to perform her duty as a spiritual master and maintain an ancient seal. One night, a violent landslide suddenly began as the seal of enchantment was broken.

A pure white fox who suddenly appeared lead Qiu Jinsha to an unknown and strange world. There, she met all kinds of monsters and half-demons with special positions in their class. As she explored, she gradually realized that it was not a mere coincidence that she came to this strange world.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630]Steam[/url]]
translation:
16岁的秋槿纱一直过着普通人的生活，却不知自己其实是灵师家族的长女。

夜里，她会独自深入山中，履行灵师的职责，维系古老的封印。某夜，结界封印突然破裂，随之发生了剧烈的山体滑坡。

一只突然出现的纯白狐狸将秋槿纱带到了一个陌生而奇异的世界。在那里，她遇见了各种怪物和半妖，也见识到它们在族群中的特殊地位。随着探索逐步深入，她渐渐意识到，自己来到这个奇异世界并非偶然。

[译自并改编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630]Steam[/url]]
